{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Fighting| type2=Steel| jtrainername=スモモ| jpokemonname=ルカリオ| trainername=Maylene| pokemonname=Lucario| tmtrainername=Sumomo| tmpokemonname=Lucario| image=[[File:Maylene Lucario.png|220px]] | caption=Maylene's Lucario | location=[[Sinnoh]] | gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed male in the games only}}| ability=Unknown| epnum=DP066| epname=Lost Leader Strategy!| prevonum=448| noevo=incap | current=[[Party|With Maylene]]| enva1=[[Bill Rogers]]| java1=[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]]| }} '''Maylene's Lucario''' (Japanese: '''スモモのルカリオ''' ''Sumomo's Lucario'') is [[Maylene]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== {{incomplete|section|2=More details on appearances}} [[File:Maylene and Lucario.png|thumb|left|220px|Lucario and Maylene]] Lucario debuted in ''[[DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!]]'', where it was battling with Maylene. Lucario used {{m|Aura Sphere}} to stop the battle of {{TP|Paul|Electabuzz}}, {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} and {{AP|Pikachu}}. It is also seen battling {{cat|Paul's Pokémon}} in a flashback, being easily defeated by {{TP|Paul|Magmar}}, first by being trapped with a {{m|Fire Spin}}, and then being finished off with a {{m|Fire Punch}} uppercut. In ''[[DP067|Crossing the Battle Line!]]'', Lucario battled in {{an|Dawn}}'s [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against Maylene. It defeated [[Dawn's Ambipom]] and Piplup. In ''[[DP068|A Triple Fighting Chance!]]'', Lucario participated in {{Ash}}'s Gym battle against Maylene. It defeated [[Ash's Staravia]] and {{AP|Chimchar}}, but was knocked out along with [[Ash's Buizel]], resulting in a tie. In ''[[DP069|Enter Galactic!]]'', Lucario helped Ash and the others defeat [[Saturn]] and [[Team Galactic]]. Lucario reappeared in a flashback in ''[[DP183|League Unleashed]]''. Lucario briefly appeared alongside Maylene during the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Lucario did not accept the fact that Maylene gave up after her loss to Paul, as seen in ''[[DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!]]'', when it fired multiple {{m|Aura Sphere}}s and {{m|Bone Rush}}es at her during their training, thought this maybe the result of some where deep down believing that she had what it took to still be a great gym leader. While stern, it cares deeply for her and will not tolerate people talking negatively about Maylene, especially shown when it sends Team Rocket flying for saying how pathetic she was. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fighting|steel|Maylene Lucario {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 6}}|0=Aura Sphere|1=Bone Rush 1|2=Metal Claw|3=Force Palm|4=Bone Rush 2|5=Bone Rush 3}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 6}}|0=Aura Sphere|1=Bone Rush (Part 1)|2=Metal Claw|3=Force Palm|4=Bone Rush (Part 2)|5=Bone Rush (Part 3)}}}} {{anmov|fighting|Aura Sphere|DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!}} {{anmov|ground|Bone Rush|DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!}} {{anmov|steel|Metal Claw|DP067|Crossing the Battle Line!}} {{anmov|fighting|Force Palm|DP067|Crossing the Battle Line!}} {{anmov/f|steel}} ==In the games== Lucario is Maylene's main Pokémon in the games. It is on her Gym team in {{3v2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}, her [[Pokémon World Tournament]] team in {{2v2|Black|White|2}}, as well as being one of her Pokéathletes in {{2v2|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}. ===In the [[core series]]=== {| ! rowspan="2" | {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}} ! colspan="2" | {{game|Platinum}} ! {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}} |- !
